title: fix(auth): when SSO is the way in, the sign-in card offers the SSO email field and button on first paint
body:
domain:ui#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jQjvWkZ7is6GXbC6DB

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbWNEBnsJNXch6gN8mBmyHTT)_

Fixes #29274

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：开了 SSO（features.sso）且密码表单被收起的部署（强制 SSO，或管理员关闭了邮箱密码登录），登录卡首屏直接给出邮箱输入框和「Sign in with SSO」按钮，不再出现密码框。
- 为什么改：之前首屏只有一句 SSO 提示和「Use a password instead」链接，唯一能用的 SSO 按钮藏在密码表单里，用户被引向一个可能根本没有的密码（JIT 开通的 SSO 用户没有密码）；关闭密码登录时，那个链接打开的密码表单服务端直接拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只改 ui/packages/auth 的 LoginForm 一个组件，未加文案键；只有「SSO 已开且密码表单收起」这一状态变化；另外，关闭了密码登录的部署，只有开了手机号+密码登录时才显示「Use a password instead」。其余状态不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx（ssoEmailFormVisible 与 SSO-only 视图里新增的 form），ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/ssoEnforcedFirstPaint-29274.test.tsx。
- 两分钟验证：OS_SSO_ENABLED=true OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true 启动并注册一个 OIDC 提供方后打开 Console /login，预期首屏有邮箱框和「Sign in with SSO」按钮、无密码框，点「Use a password instead」才出现密码框。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`: whenever the password form is collapsed (declared enforcement, `features.ssoEnforced`, or the password door shut, `emailPassword.enabled: false`) and the server advertises SSO (`features.sso`), the SSO-only view now draws its own small form on first paint: the email field (reusing `emailLabel` / `emailPlaceholder`) and the "Sign in with SSO" button (reusing `ssoButton`), submitting through the same `handleSso` that routes the email to the IdP. No password field. Under enforcement, "Use a password instead" still reveals the password form (break-glass), which keeps its own SSO button, and "Back to single sign-on" returns. With the password door shut, that link is now offered only when phone+password sign-in is on (`breakGlassOffered = !passwordSignInOff || phonePasswordEnabled`): its `ssoEnabled` term existed only because the SSO button lived inside the password form, and without phone sign-in the form it opens is one the server refuses. The provider divider shows when providers sit above the SSO email field. No new label or i18n key.

Unchanged: federated providers only (providers + link, no email field), a server whose password form is shown (password form with the SSO button inside), and the no-method statement from #29159.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/ssoEnforcedFirstPaint-29274.test.tsx`, 8 cases: under enforcement the first paint shows the email field and SSO button and no password field; submitting posts the trimmed email to `/api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso`; the break-glass link reveals the password field and comes back; divider with providers; with the password door shut and SSO advertised (`emailPassword.enabled: false`, `sso: true`, `ssoEnforced: false`) the first paint shows the email field and SSO button, no password field and no "Use a password instead" link; with phone+password also on, the link stays; controls for federated-only, a shown password form, and the no-method state.
- `LoginForm.test.tsx`: the enforced-mode case with `sso: true` read "no Email field"; it now asserts the SSO button is present and the password field absent (same file surface).
- `noSignInMethod-29159.test.tsx`: the password-off + SSO case asserted the SSO button is reached through the link; it now asserts the SSO button on the first paint and no link, with the reason in the test (the SSO way in is on the first paint since #29274).
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/auth/` from `ui/`, locked, at `86424840`: 42/42 files, 368/368 tests. Console and app-shell login suites naming `ssoEnforced` (2 files): 5/5 at `c567affc`. `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/auth`: exit 0 at `c567affc`.
- Ablations via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` at `86424840`, each over the three affected files (44 tests), each restored to blob `c35cd36c` == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - `const ssoEmailFormVisible = ssoOnlyView && ssoEnabled;` made always-false (the SSO path back behind the collapsed form): blob `c35cd36c` to `d5f586fc`; 8 red (both triggers' first-paint cases, the phone+password link case, the updated `LoginForm.test.tsx` and `noSignInMethod-29159.test.tsx` cases), controls green.
  - `breakGlassOffered` with its `ssoEnabled` term put back: blob `c35cd36c` to `94bc71d8`; 2 red (the password-shut first-paint case and the flipped #29159 case), the rest green.

## Acceptance notes

- Both triggers draw the same first-paint SSO form: declared enforcement (`features.ssoEnforced`) and the password door shut (`emailPassword.enabled: false`), each with `features.sso`. The second was first noted as out of scope and folded in on the filing seat's ruling: it collapses the same form, and there the break-glass link opens a password door the server refuses.
- On the filing seat's ruling this PR also drops the `ssoEnabled` term from the break-glass link's condition, which existed only because the SSO button lived inside the password form. The no-method state is unchanged.
- The live staging run below measured the enforcement trigger; the password-shut trigger and the link condition are held by the unit cases and the ablations.

## Verification

Live staging run at `e343cef8` (fix) against `f2bf2938` (main), Playwright Chromium, fresh context, en-US.

1. `OS_SSO_ENABLED=true OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT`; as the dev admin, `POST /api/v1/auth/sso/register` for OIDC provider `acme-sso`, domain `acme.example`: 200. `GET /api/v1/auth/config` then read `emailPassword {enabled:true, disableSignUp:true}`, `features.sso: true`, `features.ssoEnforced: true`, `socialProviders: []`.
2. Console Vite dev server from this tree (it aliases `@object-ui/auth` to source), `/login`.

| | SSO buttons | email fields | password fields | break-glass link |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before, 1280x800 first paint | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| before, 390x844 first paint | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| after, 1280x800 first paint | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| after, 390x844 first paint | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| after, 1280x800 after break-glass | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |

3. After: typing `jane@acme.example` on the first paint and clicking "Sign in with SSO" sent `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/sso`, which answered 200 with the IdP authorize URL (`https://idp.acme.example/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=acme-client...`), and the browser navigated to it.
